description: Header file defining the MobileModelRunner class for loading and interacting with mobile models in PyTorch JIT. Includes method declarations for loading models, fetching operators, bundled inputs, and running models.

classes.name: MobileModelRunner
classes.description: Class for loading, inspecting, and running mobile models in PyTorch JIT.

methods.name: set_has_metal_gpu_operators
methods.description: Checks if the list of operators includes any Metal GPU operators.

methods.name: get_operators_from_mobile_info_json
methods.description: Fetches root operators from mobile info JSON within a model archive.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Converts c10::IValue to a vector of bundled inputs.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs_map
methods.description: Converts c10::IValue to a map of bundled inputs.

methods.name: get_all_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves all bundled inputs of the loaded model.

methods.name: get_many_functions_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves bundled inputs for all functions of the model.

methods.name: has_new_style_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Checks if the model has get_bundled_inputs_functions_and_info method.

methods.name: for_each_tensor_in_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Applies a function to each tensor in bundled inputs.

methods.name: get_root_operators
methods.description: Returns root operators called by the model's bytecode.

methods.name: run_with_inputs
methods.description: Runs the model with provided inputs using the 'forward' method.

methods.name: run_with_inputs
methods.description: Runs the model with provided inputs for a specific function.

methods.name: run_argless_functions
methods.description: Runs specified functions that require no arguments.
